title: 🧹 Maintainer: Sync Cloud vs Standalone Visual Rendering in User Guide
body:
Resolves #5889

This PR updates `docs/user_guide.md` to display correctly generated screenshots, ensuring that the visual truth of the hybrid OS UI is accurately captured in our documentation. It updates the visual links in `docs/user_guide.md` and tracks the correct screenshots inside the `docs/app/` folder, overriding the local `.gitignore` rules with a manual `--force` to make sure the app screenshots are appropriately synced to the documentation folder.
